messages.text: 'It's going to be tight' - Hamilton eyes 'dream' Monza pole

metadata.summary: Lewis Hamilton is predicting a “very close” battle in Italian Grand Prix qualifying on Saturday for what he says would he says would be a “dream” pole position at Monza.
metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton eyes 'dream' Italian GP pole position for Ferrari after predicting 'very close' Monza qualifying battle | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Lewis Hamilton eyes 'dream' Italian GP pole position for Ferrari after predicting 'very close' Monza qualifying battle George Russell topped second practice for Mercedes after Charles Leclerc had led Lewis Hamilton in a Ferrari one-two in Friday's first session; watch final practice at 11.30am on Saturday ahead of Qualifying at 3pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Friday 4 September 2026 18:26, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton braces for a tight Italian GP qualifying as Mercedes continue to find more pace. Lewis Hamilton is predicting a “very close” battle in Italian Grand Prix qualifying on Saturday for what he says would he says would be a “dream” pole position at Monza. Hamilton was outperformed by his Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc in both of Friday's practice sessions but the team's overall performance, following the arrival of a new engine upgrade, suggested they have the pace to compete for pole. Leclerc topped Hamilton in first practice before Mercedes' George Russell was fastest in the second session, with Leclerc second and Hamilton only fifth behind Kimi Antonelli and McLaren's Lando Norris. messages.text: Sabalenka beats Rakhimova to reach fourth round of US Open

metadata.summary: Aryna Sabalenka came through a tough test against Kamilla Rakhimova - particularly in the second set - to reach the fourth round of the US Open.
metadata.content: US Open: Aryna Sabalenka beats Kamilla Rakhimova in straight sets to reach fourth round in Flushing Meadows | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open: Aryna Sabalenka beats Kamilla Rakhimova in straight sets to reach fourth round in Flushing Meadows Two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka comes through in straight sets against Kamilla Rakhimova, the world No 1 winning 6-3 6-4; watch US Open live on Sky Sports Tennis and Sky Sports+, on NOW and the Sky Sports app Friday 4 September 2026 18:39, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of Aryna Sabalenka and Kamilla Rakhimova against from the US Open. Aryna Sabalenka came through a tough test against Kamilla Rakhimova - particularly in the second set - to reach the fourth round of the US Open. The two-time defending champion in New York started superbly, storming into a 3-0 lead in the opening set as she didn't miss a single first serve until the seventh game of the match, in which Rakhimova would three times take her to deuce. That would prove to be Rakhimova's only real opening in the first set, Sabalenka taking it 6-3, but she'd prove much more competitive in the second. messages.text: Surrey ease relegation fears with nerve-shredding win over Yorkshire

metadata.summary: Surrey eased their County Championship relegation fears with a nerve-shredding one-wicket win over Yorkshire as last man Dan Worrall whipped away the winning four and Josh Blake battled to 43 not out off 183 deliveries after over four hours at the crease.
metadata.content: County Championship cricket: Surrey ease relegation fears with nerve-shredding win over Yorkshire at The Oval | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content County Championship cricket: Surrey ease relegation fears with nerve-shredding win over Yorkshire at The Oval Surrey edge Yorkshire by one wicket to open up daylight between themselves and the relegation zone with just second win of red-ball season; Josh Blake digs in for well over four hours before last man Dan Worrall hits winning runs; Surrey have struggled this campaign after years of success Friday 4 September 2026 19:00, UK Image: Josh Blake played a vital role for Surrey in the win over Yorkshire in just his seventh first-class match Surrey eased their County Championship relegation fears with a nerve-shredding one-wicket win over Yorkshire as last man Dan Worrall whipped away the winning four and Josh Blake battled to 43 not out off 183 deliveries after over four hours at the crease. The London side, who won the Division One title three times in a row between 2022-2024 and finished runners-up to Nottinghamshire last season, began the 11th round of fixtures just outside the bottom two after only one victory to that point. However, Surrey recorded a much-needed triumph in jittery fashion at The Kia Oval on Friday as they successfully chased down a fourth-innings target of 185 having been 115-7, with Worrall clipping Ben Coad (3-72) to the fence on the evening of day three. messages.text: Russell tops second practice as Mercedes respond to Ferrari at Monza

metadata.summary: George Russell beat Charles Leclerc to the fastest time of second practice at the Italian Grand Prix as Mercedes responded to Ferrari's early pace at Monza.
metadata.content: Italian GP: George Russell fastest in Practice Two as Mercedes edge ahead of fast-starting Ferrari at Monza | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Italian GP: George Russell fastest in Practice Two as Mercedes edge ahead of fast-starting Ferrari at Monza George Russell starts a big weekend in which Kimi Antonelli takes a grid penalty by setting Friday's fastest time at The Temple of Speed; Charles Leclerc leads Ferrari in second; watch final practice at 11.30am on Saturday ahead of Qualifying at 3pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Friday 4 September 2026 17:20, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Italian Grand Prix. George Russell beat Charles Leclerc to the fastest time of second practice at the Italian Grand Prix as Mercedes responded to Ferrari's early pace at Monza. At an event in which championship-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli will start at the back of Sunday's grid owing to engine-change penalties, Russell has a big chance to eat into the Italian's 59-point advantage if he can deliver a strong race weekend. Ferrari had finished first and second quickest in opening practice as they debuted an upgraded engine but Russell was the driver to beat in the second session amid continued sweltering temperatures in northern Italy. messages.text: Hearn: Talks 'reopened' for Fury vs AJ at Wembley

metadata.summary: Promoter Eddie Hearn has announced that talks have "reopened" to stage the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua fight at Wembley Stadium.
metadata.content: Fury vs Joshua: Eddie Hearn says talks have 'reopened' to stage British heavyweight blockbuster at Wembley Stadium | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Fury vs Joshua: Eddie Hearn says talks have 'reopened' to stage British heavyweight blockbuster at Wembley Stadium A long-awaited blockbuster fight between Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury has been stuck in negotiations in recent months amid an apparent disagreement over the location for the event, Joshua's team having remained insistent it must take place in the United Kingdom Friday 4 September 2026 17:16, UK Image: Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury could finally settle their rivalry at Wembley Stadium Promoter Eddie Hearn has announced that talks have "reopened" to stage the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua fight at Wembley Stadium. Negotiations for the Fury vs Joshua fight had hit a major stumbling block after Madison Square Garden in New York emerged as the preferred venue to stage the blockbuster bout. But Hearn has released a statement on social media, revealing that Wembley is again being considered as the venue for the fight. He wrote: "I want to thank everyone for the unbelievable support!" "You have been heard and talks have now re-opened for Wembley. "Let's make history with one of the biggest sporting moments [British flag] has ever seen."
